entries.final_answer: PS project intake was tribal knowledge held by whoever originally ran it, with no durable multi-actor doctrine to run it without the original author. This feature captures intake as reusable pack doctrine (ps-project-intake procedure, ps-intake-interview tactic, regnology-mcp-jira toolguide, ps-intake-trace template) so any PS central-tooling colleague can turn a raw request into an overview Epic plus a thin first-story set consistently, with identifiers resolved live and every external write gated on recorded human consent.
entries.question: What problem does this feature solve?
entries.rationale: The intake spec/plan and delivered artifacts converge on durability (runnable without the author), a multi-actor flow with consent gates, live resolution over cached identifiers, and reuse of regnology-jira-workflow conventions. Resolving aligns the mission record with the shipped doctrine.
